mission: At Fidelstine Charity Concerns and Orphanage, we exist to restore dignity to the abandoned and hope to the forgotten. We provide safe shelter, nourishing care, quality education, and unwavering emotional support to orphaned and vulnerable children and adults, not as charity alone, but as a sacred responsibility. Every child who walks through our doors is met with love, protection, and the tools to build a future of their own choosing.
missionShort: We provide safe shelter, nourishing care, quality education, and unwavering emotional support to orphaned and vulnerable children and adults. Every child who walks through our doors is met with love, protection, and the tools to build a future of their own choosing.
missionMore: Through compassionate caregiving, family reunification, vocational training, empowerment, and crisis response, we stand in the gap for those society has overlooked, walking with them from vulnerability to self-sufficiency, one life at a time.
vision: We envision a world where no child grows up unseen, unheard, or unloved, where every abandoned life is given a second chance at wholeness. Fidelstine aspires to be a beacon of hope across Nigeria and beyond: a home where broken stories are rewritten, where trauma gives way to resilience, and where vulnerable children and adults are equipped not just to survive, but to thrive, lead, and give back to the communities that once overlooked them.
visionShort: A world where no child grows up unseen, unheard, or unloved. A home where broken stories are rewritten and vulnerable lives are equipped not just to survive, but to thrive, lead, and give back.

values.name: Compassion
values.text: We treat every child, the less privileged, the abandoned and vulnerable adult with tenderness, patience and empathy, seeing beyond circumstance to the person within.

values.name: Dignity
values.text: We uphold the worth of every individual in our care, ensuring they are never defined by their past, but empowered by their potential.

values.name: Integrity
values.text: We operate with transparency and accountability in all we do, honouring the trust placed in us by donors, partners and communities.

values.name: Resilience
values.text: We equip those we serve with the emotional strength, education and life skills to rise above trauma and build independent lives.

values.name: Community
values.text: Healing happens in relationship: family reunification, local partnerships and a sense of belonging for every child.

values.name: Advocacy
values.text: We speak up for the rights of the vulnerable, working to influence policy and practice that protects those who cannot protect themselves.
